newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil lowers Nov interest rates to 1.78 pct - paper.
newsitem.headline: Brazil lowers Nov interest rates to 1.78 pct - paper.

text.p: Brazil's Central Bank lowered its basic monthly interest rate, known as the TBC, to 1.78 percent in November from 1.82 percent in October, Gazeta Mercantil newspaper said.

The cut, which came late on Wednesday, was slightly larger than market expectations, the newspaper said. It added that the market believed the Central Bank was going to opt for a smaller cut to encourage more foreign capital flows, which have trailed off in recent months.
Central Bank chief Gustavo Loyola, however, told the newspaper that economic activity and inflation numbers warranted the 4 basis point reduction.
The bank also lowered its basic assisstance rate, known as TBAN, to 1.90 percent in November from 1.93 percent in October. Market interest rates roughly fluctuate between the TBC and the TBAN.
